# axial knowledge base

> Everything this repository has read about evaluating LLM applications, as one file
> per topic. Fetch a file by its path. Generated by scripts/knowledge_index.py; edit the
> files, not this index.

## methodology

- [mechanizable-vs-human](knowledge/methodology/mechanizable-vs-human.md): Which eval steps a tool should own outright, which must stay human, and the grey zone between (2026-09-17)
- [methodology-spine](knowledge/methodology/methodology-spine.md): The thirteen-step error-analysis-first loop from instrumentation to production monitoring, with each step's artifact (2026-09-17)
- [numbers-and-rules-of-thumb](knowledge/methodology/numbers-and-rules-of-thumb.md): Effort, cadence, sample sizes and agreement thresholds the practitioners quote, and who quotes which (2026-09-17)
- [points-of-disagreement](knowledge/methodology/points-of-disagreement.md): Where the practitioner sources disagree on method, numbers and judge design (2026-09-17)

## procedures

- [data-contracts-at-ingest](knowledge/procedures/data-contracts-at-ingest.md): Expectation, checkpoint and data docs from Great Expectations mapped onto contract, gate and alignment report, with checks for axial ingest (2026-10-07)
- [evals-in-ci](knowledge/procedures/evals-in-ci.md): Gate a pull request on a promoted judge and keep the gate honest with deterministic checks first, intervals not points, and a saturation watch (2026-10-07)
- [factory-lifecycle](knowledge/procedures/factory-lifecycle.md): Issue to merged PR with agents doing every stage and humans at two gates, as the Warp factory examples define it (2026-10-07)
- [production-monitoring](knowledge/procedures/production-monitoring.md): Sample live traces, measure them with a promoted judge, alert on the interval's lower bound, and feed flagged traces back into review (2026-10-07)

## landscape

- [anthropic-cookbook](knowledge/landscape/anthropic-cookbook.md): Anthropic's eval notebooks and guidance, rubrics and Claude as judge; recipes to copy, nothing to install (2026-09-17)
- [arize-phoenix](knowledge/landscape/arize-phoenix.md): Arize's OpenTelemetry-based observability and eval library, source-available under Elastic License 2.0 (2026-09-17)
- [braintrust-autoevals](knowledge/landscape/braintrust-autoevals.md): Braintrust's closed eval platform and autoevals, its open scorer library for heuristic, embedding and LLM-judge scores (2026-09-17)
- [deepeval](knowledge/landscape/deepeval.md): Pytest-style LLM eval library with 60+ built-in metrics and a paid Confident AI dashboard above it (2026-09-17)
- [dspy](knowledge/landscape/dspy.md): Stanford's framework that treats an eval metric as the optimisation objective for prompts and few-shots (2026-09-17)
- [evalgen](knowledge/landscape/evalgen.md): Shankar et al.'s research prototype that picks judge prompts by agreement with human grades and names criteria drift (2026-09-17)
- [evals-skills](knowledge/landscape/evals-skills.md): The AI Evals course's agent skills, error-discovery and validate-evaluator, which count Pass as the positive class (2026-10-07)
- [evidently](knowledge/landscape/evidently.md): Open-source ML and LLM evaluation and monitoring; Reports and Tests, descriptors, LLM judges, tracing, scheduled evals (2026-10-07)
- [great-expectations](knowledge/landscape/great-expectations.md): Data-quality contracts for pipelines, with expectation suites, checkpoints that stop a run, and Data Docs as the record (2026-10-07)
- [helm](knowledge/landscape/helm.md): Stanford CRFM's holistic foundation-model benchmark framework, in maintenance mode since June 2026 (2026-09-17)
- [inspect-ai](knowledge/landscape/inspect-ai.md): UK AISI's open harness for model and agent evals, with datasets, solvers, scorers, sandboxed agents and a local log viewer (2026-10-07)
- [landscape-overview](knowledge/landscape/landscape-overview.md): Two families of eval tools, benchmarking and application evals, and why none closes the error-analysis-first gap (2026-10-07)
- [langfuse](knowledge/landscape/langfuse.md): Open-source LLM engineering platform for tracing, datasets, evals and annotation queues; MIT since June 2025 (2026-09-17)
- [langsmith](knowledge/landscape/langsmith.md): LangChain's closed eval and tracing platform, with open evaluator classes in the client libraries (2026-09-17)
- [lm-evaluation-harness](knowledge/landscape/lm-evaluation-harness.md): EleutherAI's standard harness for reproducible few-shot benchmark evaluation of foundation models (2026-09-17)
- [openai-evals](knowledge/landscape/openai-evals.md): OpenAI's slowing open-source eval registry and the hosted Evals API its docs now steer users to (2026-09-17)
- [opik](knowledge/landscape/opik.md): Comet's open-source observability and evaluation platform with pytest integration and a prompt optimizer (2026-09-17)
- [promptfoo](knowledge/landscape/promptfoo.md): CLI and Node library for prompt and model testing and red-teaming, driven by a YAML config of prompts, providers, tests and asserts (2026-09-17)
- [pydantic-evals](knowledge/landscape/pydantic-evals.md): Pydantic AI's typed Case, Dataset, Evaluator and LLMJudge, with no judge-to-human agreement measurement (2026-10-07)
- [pytest-evals](knowledge/landscape/pytest-evals.md): A thin pytest plugin for running and aggregating LLM eval cases as ordinary tests in existing CI (2026-09-17)
- [ragas](knowledge/landscape/ragas.md): RAG-specific evaluation and synthetic test-set generation over question, answer, contexts and ground truth (2026-09-17)
- [wandb-weave](knowledge/landscape/wandb-weave.md): Weights & Biases tracing and evaluation SDK, usable only with a W&B account for storage and the UI (2026-09-17)
- [warp-factories](knowledge/landscape/warp-factories.md): Warp's agent factory as files, with foreman, triage, spec, implement and review agents, automations, runners and self-grading scorers (2026-10-07)
